definitions.explanation: A morpheme added to the beginning of a word to modify its meaning or create a new word. A term used in linguistics and grammar study.

examples.japanese: 「お」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧{接頭辞|せっとうじ}だ。
examples.english: 'O' is a prefix that expresses politeness.

examples.japanese: 「{不|ふ}」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧{接頭辞|せっとうじ}だ。
examples.english: 'Fu' is a prefix that expresses negation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接頭辞|せっとうじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{接尾辞|せつびじ}→接尾辞：16601_setsubiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{語彙力|ごいりょく}→語彙力：09906_goiryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛躍的|ひやくてき}→飛躍的：21896_hiyakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Understanding Japanese prefixes and suffixes dramatically improves your vocabulary.

notes:
{接頭辞|せっとうじ} is a linguistics term meaning "prefix" — a morpheme added to the beginning of a word. Understanding prefixes is very helpful for building vocabulary.

FORMS:
{接|せつ} (connect) + ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ (head/beginning) + {辞|じ} (word element)

COMMON JAPANESE PREFIXES:
- お / ご: politeness (⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧, ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧)
- {不|ふ} / ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ / ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧: negation (⟦{不|ふ}{可能|かのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧, ⟦{無|む}{料|りょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧, ⟦{非|ひ}{公式|こうしき}→非公式：20590_hikoushiki⟧)
- {大|だい} / ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧: emphasis (⟦{大|だい}{好|す}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧, ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧)
- ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧: re- (⟦{再|さい}{利用|りよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接頭辞|せっとうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to attach a prefix)
- {接頭辞|せっとうじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{接尾辞|せつびじ}→接尾辞：16601_setsubiji⟧ (prefixes and suffixes)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{接尾辞|せつびじ}→接尾辞：16601_setsubiji⟧ (suffix — attached to the end of a word).
